items.title: Instant payment scam protections lag behind cards
items.summary: Instant payment scam protections lag behind cards The consumer group published analysis of instant payment systems warning that scam protections lag behind card protections, and called on the regulator to mandate reimbursement for authorised push payment fraud and require banks to publish scam data covering two thousand surveyed consumers.
